columns.name: skill_assessments
columns.type: Array(Tuple(String, Enum8('observed-used' = 1, 'no-observed-use' = 2, 'unknown' = 3), Enum8('none' = 0, 'session' = 1, 'run' = 2, 'agent' = 3), String, Enum8('complete' = 1, 'partial' = 2, 'unavailable' = 3), Enum8('readable' = 1, 'reference-only' = 2, 'denied' = 3, 'truncated' = 4, 'unavailable' = 5, 'unknown' = 6)))

columns.name: context_facets
columns.type: Array(Tuple(Enum8('agents-instructions' = 1, 'claude-instructions' = 2, 'plans' = 3, 'hooks' = 4, 'mcp' = 5, 'package-context' = 6), String, Enum8('present' = 1, 'absent' = 2, 'unknown' = 3), Enum8('complete' = 1, 'denied' = 2, 'excluded' = 3, 'truncated' = 4, 'unavailable' = 5), Enum8('readable' = 1, 'reference-only' = 2, 'denied' = 3, 'truncated' = 4, 'unavailable' = 5, 'unknown' = 6), UInt32))

definitions.comment: Compact latest-state index for versioned repository/session evidence captures. Organization and repository filters lead the replacing identity; unknown coverage remains explicit.

definitions.name: session_git_observations

columns.name: organization_id
columns.comment: Owning organization ID; first tenant boundary.

columns.name: user_id
columns.comment: Uploading account ID; second tenant boundary.

columns.name: source
columns.comment: Transcript source: claude_code or codex; part of session identity.

columns.name: session_id
columns.comment: Native session ID within organization, user and source.

columns.name: revision
columns.comment: Exact raw transcript revision used by this extraction generation.

columns.name: parser_version
columns.comment: Generation version: git extractor version times 256 plus transcript parser version; retries replace only the same generation.

columns.name: transcript_parser_version
columns.comment: Published transcript records parser version consumed by the extractor.

columns.name: agent_id
columns.comment: Transcript stream agent ID; empty for the main stream.

columns.name: record_idx
columns.comment: One-based raw JSONL record index; 4294967295 is the completion receipt.

columns.name: block_idx
columns.comment: Source content block index times 65536 plus output match ordinal; zero for metadata and receipts.

columns.name: call_id
columns.comment: Observed tool call ID, paired within the same agent stream; empty for metadata and receipts.

columns.name: kind
columns.comment: commit_created, push_range, pr_url, mcp_pr_created, codex_session_meta, or internal receipt.

columns.name: short_sha
columns.comment: Observed abbreviated commit SHA; never expanded or attributed here.

columns.name: branch
columns.comment: Secret-filtered observed commit, push target or session metadata branch; capped at 512 characters.

columns.name: subject_sha256
columns.comment: SHA256 of the observed commit subject; subject text is never stored.

columns.name: push_from_sha
columns.comment: Observed abbreviated SHA before a push range; empty for other kinds.

columns.name: push_to_sha
columns.comment: Observed abbreviated SHA after a push range; empty for other kinds.

columns.name: push_source_branch
columns.comment: Secret-filtered observed push source branch; capped at 512 characters.

columns.name: pr_repo
columns.comment: Secret-filtered GitHub owner/name from an observed pull request URL; capped at 512 characters.

columns.name: pr_number
columns.comment: Observed GitHub pull request number; zero when not applicable.

columns.name: commit_hash
columns.comment: Observed full commit hash in Codex session metadata; not a resolved short SHA.

columns.name: repository_url
columns.comment: Secret-filtered repository URL from Codex metadata; credentials removed and capped at 512 characters.

columns.name: ts
columns.comment: UTC millisecond timestamp of the evidence record, or receipt publication.

columns.name: label
columns.comment: Evidence label observed; a receipt is an internal completion marker, not evidence.

definitions.comment: Deterministic observed git and GitHub PR evidence from published transcript records. Receipts commit bounded extraction generations; no resolver or attribution.

columns.name: agent_runs
columns.type: Array(Tuple(String, DateTime64(3, 'UTC'), Float64, String, UInt8, String))

definitions.name: skill_receipts
definitions.comment: Latest completed skill extraction run per workspace, user, agent, and session.

definitions.name: skill_uses
definitions.comment: Versioned session skill uses bound to an exact completed extraction receipt. Mutable usage timestamps and content hashes are excluded from the replacing key.

definitions.name: skill_version_contents
definitions.comment: User-erasable product-readable SKILL.md bodies keyed by workspace, exact skill name, SHA-256, and uploader.

definitions.name: transcript_records
definitions.comment: Deterministic per-record transcript index for selective reads. Light columns answer structure questions; text is read only for explicit record drill-downs.

definitions.name: usage_events
definitions.comment: Versioned request-level usage facts and per-generation extraction receipts. Mutable timestamp/model fields are deliberately excluded from the replacing key.

definitions.as:
SELECT * EXCEPT (_dedupe_rank) FROM ( WITH ( length(cs.content) > 120000000 OR countSubstrings(cs.content, '
') > 8000 ) AS _is_capped, if(_is_capped, '', cs.content) AS _line_safe_content, substring(cs.content, 1, 20000000) AS _error_sample_content, arrayFilter( x -> JSONExtractString(x, 'type') IN ('user', 'assistant'), splitByChar('
', _line_safe_content) ) AS _interaction_lines, arrayFilter(x -> JSONHas(x, 'timestamp'), _interaction_lines) AS _ts_lines, arrayMap( x -> parseDateTime64BestEffort(JSONExtractString(x, 'timestamp')), _ts_lines ) AS _timestamps, arrayMap( x -> JSONExtractString(x, 'type'), _ts_lines ) AS _msg_types, if(length(_timestamps) > 1, arrayMap(i -> dateDiff('second', _timestamps[i], _timestamps[i+1]), range(1, length(_timestamps))), [] ) AS _prompt_periods_sec, if(length(_timestamps) > 1, arrayMap(i -> if(_msg_types[i] = 'user' AND _msg_types[i+1] = 'assistant', dateDiff('second', _timestamps[i], _timestamps[i+1]), 0), range(1, length(_timestamps))), [] ) AS _inference_gaps, if(length(_timestamps) > 1, arrayMap(i -> if(_msg_types[i] = 'assistant' AND _msg_types[i+1] = 'user', dateDiff('second', _timestamps[i], _timestamps[i+1]), 0), range(1, length(_timestamps))), [] ) AS _human_gaps, arrayFilter( x -> JSONExtractString(x, 'type') = 'assistant' AND JSONHas(x, 'message'), splitByChar('
', _line_safe_content) ) AS _assistant_lines, arrayMap( x -> JSONExtractString(JSONExtractRaw(x, 'message'), 'id'), _assistant_lines ) AS _assistant_ids, arrayFilter( (x, i) -> i = length(_assistant_ids) OR _assistant_ids[i] != _assistant_ids[i + 1], _assistant_lines, arrayEnumerate(_assistant_lines) ) AS _deduped_assistant_lines, arraySum(arrayMap(x -> toUInt64OrZero(JSONExtractRaw(JSONExtractRaw(x, 'message'), 'usage', 'input_tokens')) + toUInt64OrZero(JSONExtractRaw(JSONExtractRaw(x, 'message'), 'usage', 'cache_read_input_tokens')) + toUInt64OrZero(JSONExtractRaw(JSONExtractRaw(x, 'message'), 'usage', 'cache_creation_input_tokens')), _deduped_assistant_lines)) AS _input_tokens, arraySum(arrayMap(x -> toUInt64OrZero(JSONExtractRaw(JSONExtractRaw(x, 'message'), 'usage', 'output_tokens')), _deduped_assistant_lines)) AS _output_tokens, arraySum(arrayMap(x -> toUInt64OrZero(JSONExtractRaw(JSONExtractRaw(x, 'message'), 'usage', 'cache_read_input_tokens')), _deduped_assistant_lines)) AS _cache_read, arraySum(arrayMap(x -> toUInt64OrZero(JSONExtractRaw(JSONExtractRaw(x, 'message'), 'usage', 'cache_creation_input_tokens')), _deduped_assistant_lines)) AS _cache_creation, arrayDistinct(arrayFilter(x -> x != '', extractAll(cs.content, '"name":"Skill"[^}]*"skill":"([^"]+)"'))) AS _skills, arrayDistinct(arrayFilter(x -> x != '', extractAll(cs.content, '"name":"Task"[^}]*"subagent_type":"([^"]+)"'))) AS _subagent_types, arrayDistinct(arrayFilter(x -> x != '', extractAll(cs.content, '<command-name>/([^<]+)</command-name>'))) AS _slash_commands, arraySort(agent -> tupleElement(agent, 1), arrayMap( (agent_id, transcript) -> tuple( agent_id, arrayElement(arrayMap( line -> JSONExtractString(line, 'message', 'model'), arrayFilter( line -> JSONExtractString(line, 'type') = 'assistant' AND JSONExtractString(line, 'message', 'model') != '', splitByChar('
', if( length(transcript) > 120000000 OR countSubstrings(transcript, '
') > 8000, '', transcript )) ) ), -1) ), mapKeys(cs.subagents), mapValues(cs.subagents) )) AS _native_subagents, toUInt32( length(extractAll(_error_sample_content, '"isApiErrorMessage":true')) + length(extractAll(_error_sample_content, '"is_error":true')) ) AS _error_count, if(_is_capped, cs.session_date, arrayMin(_timestamps)) AS _session_date, if(_is_capped, cs.last_interaction_date, arrayMax(_timestamps)) AS _last_interaction_date, dateDiff('minute', _session_date, _last_interaction_date) AS _duration_min SELECT * EXCEPT (session_date, last_interaction_date, content, subagents), _session_date as session_date, _last_interaction_date as last_interaction_date, 'claude_code' as source, _input_tokens as input_tokens, _output_tokens as output_tokens, _cache_read as cache_read_input_tokens, _cache_creation as cache_creation_input_tokens, _input_tokens + _output_tokens as total_tokens, _skills as skills, _slash_commands as slash_commands, _subagent_types as subagent_types, toUInt32(length(cs.subagents)) as subagent_count, _native_subagents as native_subagents, toUInt32(length(_timestamps)) as total_interactions, toUInt32(_duration_min) as actual_duration_min, if(length(_prompt_periods_sec) > 0, round(arrayAvg(_prompt_periods_sec), 2), 0) as avg_period_sec, if( length(_prompt_periods_sec) > 0, toFloat64(arrayElement( arraySort(_prompt_periods_sec), toUInt64(ceil(length(_prompt_periods_sec) / 2)) )), 0 ) as median_period_sec, toUInt32(arrayCount(x -> x < 5, _prompt_periods_sec)) as quick_responses, toUInt32(arrayCount(x -> x >= 5 AND x <= 60, _prompt_periods_sec)) as normal_responses, toUInt32(arrayCount(x -> x > 300, _prompt_periods_sec)) as long_pauses, _error_count as error_count, if( _error_count = 0, '', multiIf( _error_sample_content ILIKE '%OperationFailed%', 'OperationFailed', _error_sample_content ILIKE '%UnknownError%', 'UnknownError', _error_sample_content ILIKE '%ORPCError%', 'ORPCError', _error_sample_content ILIKE '%TimeoutError%', 'TimeoutError', _error_sample_content ILIKE '%TypeError%', 'TypeError', _error_sample_content ILIKE '%ReferenceError%', 'ReferenceError', _error_sample_content ILIKE '%Error:%', if( length(extractAll(_error_sample_content, '([A-Z][a-zA-Z]+Error):')) > 0, arrayElement(extractAll(_error_sample_content, '([A-Z][a-zA-Z]+Error):'), 1), 'GenericError' ), _error_sample_content ILIKE '%Exception:%', if( length(extractAll(_error_sample_content, '([A-Z][a-zA-Z]+Exception):')) > 0, arrayElement(extractAll(_error_sample_content, '([A-Z][a-zA-Z]+Exception):'), 1), 'Exception' ), _error_sample_content ILIKE '%error:%', 'GenericError', _error_sample_content ILIKE '%failed%', 'OperationFailed', _error_sample_content ILIKE '%timeout%', 'Timeout', _error_sample_content ILIKE '%not found%', 'NotFound', 'UnknownError' ) ) as error_pattern, if( _is_capped, '', JSONExtractString( JSONExtractRaw( arrayElement( arrayFilter( x -> JSONExtractString(x, 'type') = 'assistant', splitByChar('
', _line_safe_content) ), -1 ), 'message' ), 'model' ) ) as model_used, toUInt8(if(cs.git_sha IS NOT NULL AND cs.git_sha != '', 1, 0)) as has_commit, toUInt8(if(position(cs.content, '"name":"EnterPlanMode"') > 0, 1, 0)) as used_plan_mode, toUInt32(arraySum(_inference_gaps)) as inference_duration_sec, toUInt32(arraySum(_human_gaps)) as human_duration_sec, CASE WHEN _duration_min <= 10 AND (_input_tokens + _output_tokens) < 500000 AND _output_tokens > 1000 THEN 'quick_win' WHEN _duration_min > 30 AND _output_tokens > 50000 AND cs.git_sha IS NOT NULL AND cs.git_sha != '' THEN 'deep_work' WHEN (_input_tokens + _output_tokens) > 1000000 AND (_output_tokens / nullif(_input_tokens, 0)) < 0.3 AND _duration_min > 20 THEN 'struggle' WHEN length(_skills) >= 3 AND (cs.git_sha IS NULL OR cs.git_sha = '') AND (_input_tokens + _output_tokens) > 200000 THEN 'exploration' WHEN _duration_min < 3 AND _output_tokens < 500 THEN 'abandoned' ELSE 'standard' END as session_archetype, toUInt8( greatest( toFloat64(0), least( toFloat64(100), round( toFloat64(50) + if(cs.git_sha IS NOT NULL AND cs.git_sha != '', 20, 0) + if((_output_tokens / nullif(_input_tokens, 0)) > 0.5, 15, 0) + (least(toUInt32(length(_skills)), 3) * 5) - if( (_input_tokens + _output_tokens) > 1500000 AND (cs.git_sha IS NULL OR cs.git_sha = ''), 20, 0 ) - if(_duration_min < 2 AND _output_tokens < 200, 30, 0) - (least(_error_count, toUInt32(10)) * 2) ) ) ) ) as success_score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY cs.organization_id, cs.user_id, cs.session_id ORDER BY cs.revision DESC ) AS _dedupe_rank FROM rudel.claude_sessions AS cs WHERE _is_capped OR length(_timestamps) > 0 ) WHERE _dedupe_rank = 1
